pull.title: ci: Switch to self-hosted CDash
pull.body:
Switch our CDash submissions from my.cdash.org to our self-hosted instance at https://cdash.fish.foo/index.php?project=bitcoin-core.

my.cdash.org sometimes deletes our logs extremely quickly. That leaves too little time to investigate failures and makes links to earlier results 404, which is annoying.

The new instance runs on a dedicated Hetzner VPS and gives us control over retention. Submissions are configured to be retained for 90 days, and the project's build retention is also set to 90 days.

little time to investigate failures or refer back to earlier results.

Submit results to cdash.fish.foo, our own CDash instance hosted on a
dedicated Hetzner VPS, so we can control retention. It is currently
configured to retain log submissions for 90 days.

comments.body:
> This also changes the nightly start time from 00:00 UTC to 01:23 UTC (slightly "randomised" from 00:00 to reduce contention on nightlies).

`CTEST_NIGHTLY_START_TIME` is not used as a job start trigger, so it cannot cause any contention. Rather, it serves as the boundary between "days".
Oh, nice. Well I'll reset that to 00:00 UTC then!
